definitions.explanation: A flash of light in the sky caused by an electrical discharge during a thunderstorm.

examples.japanese: {稲妻|いなずま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}った→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
{稲妻|いなずま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: Thunder rumbled immediately after the lightning.

examples.japanese: {稲妻|いなずま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い／早い：00514_hayai⟧。

notes:
The word {稲妻|いなずま} literally means 'rice plant husband/spouse' (⟦{稲|いな}→稲：01820_ine⟧ = rice plant, ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧ = spouse). Ancient Japanese believed lightning helped rice plants grow, viewing it as the 'husband' that made rice 'pregnant' with grain.

Also written as ⟦{電|いなずま}→電：noentry⟧ or ⟦{電光|いなずま}→電光：noentry⟧.

Related vocabulary:
- ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧ (thunder; also used for lightning in general)
- ⟦{落雷|らくらい}→落雷：07379_rakurai⟧ (lightning strike)
- ⟦{雷光|らいこう}→雷光：29218_raikou⟧ (lightning flash - formal)
- ⟦{稲光|いなびかり}→稲光：27670_inabikari⟧ (lightning flash - poetic)

Expressions:
- {稲妻|いなずま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (lightning streaks across)
- {稲妻|いなずま}⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (zigzag pattern, like lightning)
